project.name: osgi/manifests/manifests-cdk8s
project.description: The cdk8s carrier bundle for the manifests domain: it embeds the flat (non-OSGi) cdk8s closure — cdk8s, software.constructs, jsii-runtime and the jetbrains annotations — INTACT into its Bundle-ClassPath (-includeresource …;lib:=true), then exports org.cdk8s and software.constructs to the OSGi world. cdk8s is a manifests concern, not a host seam: this keeps it on the BUNDLE side of the two-world boundary (a real Export-Package wired bundle-to-bundle), so manifests-core and the contributed cdk8s-rendering fragments (e.g. systemd-cdk8s-manifests) resolve cdk8s without the host-flat system-packages leak. One bundle owns the embedding; everyone else attaches or imports.
